entries: Verify the latest release has a valid attestation: `gh release verify`
Verify a specific release by tag: `gh release verify v1.2.3`
Verify an asset from the latest release: `gh release verify-asset my-asset.zip`
Verify a local asset file originated from a specific release: `gh release verify-asset v1.2.3 my-asset.zip`

title.zh-TW: gh 新增 release verify 指令，確認發行版沒被人動過手腳
title.en: gh adds a release verify command so you can confirm a release hasn't been tampered with

body.zh-TW: 你打包版本發布給同事下載，或反過來下載別人放上去的檔案，想確認沒被偷換——這正是 gh 新增的 `release verify` 與 `release verify-asset` 要處理的事。每個發行版能附上一份 attestation（證明文件，帶簽章與時間戳，把版本、git 標籤與檔案綁在一起）。⟦就像精品出廠附的保證書印著編號跟日期，對得起來才確定是真品，沒被掉包。⟧驗證最新的發行版，打 `gh release verify`；驗證特定版本，加上標籤打 `gh release verify v1.2.3`。手上某個附件檔案，想對到最新發行版，打 `gh release verify-asset my-asset.zip`；要對到特定版本，標籤也加進去，打 `gh release verify-asset v1.2.3 my-asset.zip`。
body.en: You've packaged a release for coworkers to download, or you're the one downloading something someone else uploaded, and you want to be sure it wasn't swapped for something else — that's what gh's new `release verify` and `release verify-asset` handle. Every release can carry an attestation, a signed, timestamped document that ties the release to its version, its git tag, and its files. ⟦It's like a luxury item's warranty card printed with a serial number and a date — if they match, you know it's the real thing and nothing's been switched.⟧ To verify the latest release, run `gh release verify`; to verify a specific one, add the tag: `gh release verify v1.2.3`. Got an asset file you want to match against the latest release? Run `gh release verify-asset my-asset.zip`; to match it against a specific release, add the tag too: `gh release verify-asset v1.2.3 my-asset.zip`.

items.original:
Verify the latest release has a valid attestation: `gh release verify`
Verify a specific release by tag: `gh release verify v1.2.3`
Verify an asset from the latest release: `gh release verify-asset my-asset.zip`
Verify a local asset file originated from a specific release: `gh release verify-asset v1.2.3 my-asset.zip`

title.zh-TW: gh 新增 agent-task 指令組，在終端機裡派工給程式碼代理
title.en: gh adds an agent-task command group to hand code work to the coding agent from your terminal

body.zh-TW:
剩一段程式碼想整理，你正忙著別的事，於是把它交給 GitHub 的 coding agent（程式碼代理，替你動手改程式的自動助手）——gh 新增的 `agent-task` 指令組，就是在終端機裡派工與追蹤的工具。

```
gh agent-task create "refactor the codebase"   # 派一件工作出去
gh agent-task list                             # 列出你所有任務
gh agent-task view 1234                        # 看某一件的細節
gh agent-task view 1234 --log --follow         # 邊跑邊看
```

最後那個寫法會即時印出執行紀錄（log，程式跑的時候一行一行留下的文字）。同一組指令另外給了三個順手的別名，`gh agent-tasks`、`gh agent`、`gh agents` 打起來都通。⟦一個人有本名，也有幾個熟人喊的小名，喊哪一個，到場的都是同一位。⟧這組指令還在預覽階段，用法可能說改就改，不會事先通知。
body.en:
You've got a chunk of code that needs cleaning up but you're busy with something else, so you hand it to GitHub's coding agent — an automated assistant that edits code for you. gh's new `agent-task` command group is how you dispatch and track that work right from the terminal.

```
gh agent-task create "refactor the codebase"   # send off a task
gh agent-task list                             # list all your tasks
gh agent-task view 1234                        # see details on one
gh agent-task view 1234 --log --follow         # watch it run live
```

That last form streams the log in real time as the task runs. The same command group ships with three handy aliases — `gh agent-tasks`, `gh agent`, and `gh agents` all work the same way. ⟦You go by your given name, but the people who know you well call you by a nickname too — whichever one gets used, it's still you who shows up.⟧ The command group is still in preview, so its behavior can change without notice.
